what: *** He is entered in the tree as "Roberto Paul (Llorens) Lerena", with 15 media objects. ***
count: So the Buenos Aires candidate - which David says arrived unsolicited from an Argentine researcher and is likely no relation - *** has already been written into the family's own tree as part of his name. *** That is how a stranger's guess becomes a fact: nobody refutes it in writing, so it sits in the name field for years. It is refuted at /family-papers/.

what: *** "Mary Ann Taylor Death Certificate" is attached to Mary Septima Taylor. ***
count: *** Her MOTHER's death certificate. *** Mary Ann Hellen Taylor, born Brayley, died 1900 - the death that orphaned Mary Septima at fifteen and set up the emigration. This archive does not hold it and has never seen it. *** It is the direct route into the BRAYLEY wall, which the DNA independently pointed at the same day. ***

count: A photograph of the grave. The family say Newlands; the death certificate says Maitland. *** A photograph may settle which. ***
